nodes.label: Correction Under One Writer Lock
nodes.rationale: The Store holds one writer lock from the correction read through validation, persistence and projection so concurrent corrections cannot silently discard one another; CLI and MCP pass corrections to the same Store boundary.

nodes.label: Explicit Links Replace the Full List
nodes.rationale: An active source may link only to distinct active targets in the same store; an explicit list replaces the complete set while omission preserves historical relationships, keeping link mutation an audited decision.

nodes.label: T0 Exact-Text Duplicate Supersession
nodes.rationale: Automatic supersession demands identical parsed content and semantic fields under exact text comparison, oldest copy stays active; similarity alone belongs to the reviewed proposal path.
